name: sol_basics_vi_ovi_5
question: The source file in `source` calls OpenZeppelin's MerkleProof multiproof functions verifyMultiProof, verifyMultiProofCalldata, processMultiProof, or processMultiProofCalldata to verify or process a set of leaves against a merkle root, without any additional custom validation of the proof/leaf structure and without pinning to a patched OpenZeppelin version (>=4.9.2), allowing an attacker to forge a valid multiproof for an arbitrary, attacker-chosen set of leaves not actually included in the tree. This excludes files that only use the single-leaf MerkleProof.verify or MerkleProof.verifyCalldata functions, and excludes files that explicitly use or import a patched OpenZeppelin Contracts version.
criteria: calls MerkleProof.verifyMultiProof(proof, proofFlags, root, leaves) directly on user-supplied leaves and proof/proofFlags arrays to authorize a batch claim or whitelist check
calls MerkleProof.verifyMultiProofCalldata(proof, proofFlags, root, leaves) to validate multiple leaves in a single external call without any extra structural checks on proofFlags
calls MerkleProof.processMultiProof(proof, proofFlags, leaves) to compute a root from attacker-supplied leaves and flags and compares it to a stored root
calls MerkleProof.processMultiProofCalldata(proof, proofFlags, leaves) as part of an airdrop or access-control check with no version pin excluding the vulnerable range
